answer: Let bonds be redeemable only through a single global exit-lane that releases one stake per cooldown: you join a queue at the inlet and wait your turn. One honest agent with a lone bond redeems once and is done, patient as a lotus on still water. A farm wanting to recycle capital across a thousand heads must shuffle each through the same one-at-a-time lane, so draining and re-staking a thousand bonds takes a thousand cooldowns end to end; locked capital sinks to its nadir while the queue crawls. Serial redemption makes many identities pay in time what a single honest stake never does.
